reason: Modifying the mount options for the /boot/efi partition alters the system's boot filesystem. An error in /etc/fstab can prevent the EFI system partition from mounting, leading to an unbootable system. Because this change touches a critical boot component, it is considered too risky to automate without direct human oversight.
estimated_impact: reboot required; filesystems affected; Potential boot failure if fstab syntax is incorrect; Inability to mount EFI system partition; Loss of console or remote access during reboot
